name: Youen MY MOTHER -Kyonyuu Souzoku-
source:
My father had died. Because I received this message from my mother, I went home for the first time in these two years in order to attend the funeral. Because my father had married her while I was in the boarding school, it was the first time to see her. My father was born in a rich family, but he was very lavish, and it was his fourth marriage. I opened the door, and I saw a woman. It was my mother-in-law. Although it was the first time I saw her, she was the picture of my real mother. It sounds shameless, but I got the urge to fall on her bosom as I used to do when I was a child.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6521]ANN[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世了。收到母亲的消息后，我为了参加葬礼，时隔两年第一次回家。父亲在我寄宿学校期间娶了她，所以这是我第一次见到她。父亲出身富裕家庭，却挥霍无度，这是他的第四次婚姻。我打开门，看见一个女人。那是我的继母。虽然是第一次见面，她却和我亲生母亲一模一样。说来无耻，我突然想像小时候那样扑进她的怀里。

[来自[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6521]ANN[/url]]
